title: The Guard of g7
setup: Your queen and bishop both bear down on g7, and the knight on e8 is the only piece besides the king covering that square.
hint: Mate is one move away and one black piece prevents it. Which piece covers g7, and what can reach it?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rxe8}} takes the knight that covers g7. The recapture {{Rxe8}} does nothing for the king, and {{Qg7#}} finishes: the queen is held by the bishop on b2 and Black has no square left. When mate is one move away, price the defender, not the piece.
